notes.subject: החלו
notes.rationale: Sapos 'ol prinsis i wokim king i kamap sik' (KJV, JPS) o 'ol prinsis yet i kamap sik' (ASV, YLT) — em i skim bilong king o ol prinsis yet.

notes.subject: את
notes.rationale: את long Hos 7:5 em i preposisen 'wantaim' (Strong 854), i no mak bilong direkt objekt; mi tanim 'wantaim' na gloss bilong ⟨את⟩ i stap kas.

translation: De bilong king bilong mipela; ol prinsis i kirap sik long het bilong wain; em i stretim han bilong en wantaim ⟨את⟩ ol man i masal ol arapela.
